name: 06-cost-aware-mode-selection
claim: A coherent single-page build selects Solo or Lean and does not invent a Full swarm without evidence of independent multi-layer work.
prompt: Use the swarmagents skill to build one static responsive marketing page from an already-approved design. There is no backend, database, authentication, deployment, or external integration. State the selected execution mode and staffing before implementation.
grading_notes: PASS if the transcript selects Solo (preferred) or Lean with a concrete reason and a small team that retains independent verification. FAIL if it selects Full or creates numerous page-section workers merely because the page has several visual sections.
